## What this PR does

A clear, concise description of the change.

## Why

Link to the issue it fixes (if any) and a sentence about the motivation.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup (no behavior change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests only
- [ ] Translations / i18n
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` exits 0
- [ ] `npm run build:ui` exits 0
- [ ] `npm test` passes (no failures)
- [ ] If I touched i18n, both `TR` (renderer) and `TRANSLATIONS` (RAG) are updated
- [ ] If I added a user-facing string, it goes through `t()` (renderer) or `TRANSLATIONS` (RAG)
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [GOVERNANCE.md](../GOVERNANCE.md)

## Out-of-scope changes

If your PR includes any of the following, **call them out explicitly** so the
reviewer doesn't miss them:

- Changes to the build pipeline
- Changes to the scraper or its target sites
- Changes to the prompt template
- Changes to the data on-disk format
- Changes to file paths outside `src/`

## Testing

What did you test? How? Include repro steps if it's a bug fix.

## Screenshots / logs

If the change is visible, attach a screenshot. If it changed behavior, attach
relevant log output.
